scope: Every currently tracked visual asset, including historical concepts, sources, raster exports, SVG artwork, UI slices, atomic components, overlays, atlas and compatibility aliases. Excludes unrelated untracked unity-download-resume.
constraints: Keep each existing tracked path and pixel canvas / SVG viewport size.
Keep transparent output modes and intentional layer separation; record actual native generated sizes separately.
Preserve existing 124-frame atlas XML names, rectangles and 7912x6088 canvas.
Preserve 32 movement file names, 1254x1254 canvas, foot anchor y=1179, timing/order.
Preserve UI nine-slice contracts and dynamic text separation unless an explicit new contract is reviewed.
Old v6 preserve-92-hashes checks are obsolete for this v7 user-requested full redraw.
Sources and historical concept files are included; there is no implicit keep-approved exemption.
